start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter, yani boundary ki total length, padhenge. Aapko kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Koi baat nahi, Kabir. Sochiye aap vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing laga rahe hain—fencing ki total length ko kya kahenge?
Kabir, sawaal confusing tha—sorry. Perimeter matlab shape ki sabhi sides ko jodna. Rectangle ki chaar sides kaise jodenge?
Kabir, aapko ye part boring lag raha hai—chaliye mode badalte hain: game, picture, ya quick challenge? Aap ek choose kijiye.

turns.line: mujhe gussa aa raha hai, ye samajh nahi aa raha
